hero.title: Senior Backend Engineer
hero.description: Building production backends in <ink>Node.js and TypeScript</ink> for fintech, banking and Web3. Now focused on <accent>privacy-first</accent>, decentralized, peer-to-peer software on the <ink>Holepunch/Pear</ink> stack.

zuvia.name: Zuvia · Tokenized Asset Platform
zuvia.description: The platform behind Brazil's first real estate tokenization on B3 infrastructure, with R$300M+ in transaction volume. Event-driven Node.js microservices on PostgreSQL, Solidity contracts and multisig wallets for 8,000+ investors.

retry.name: retry · Peer-to-Peer Interviews
retry.description: Asynchronous interviews that run peer-to-peer on Pear. Candidates re-record until it's right, and only the take they send ever exists. Blind-pairing invites, Hyperdrive replication and on-device AI. No server, no API calls.

ecommerce.name: Event-Driven E-commerce · Kafka Microservices
ecommerce.description: NestJS microservices over Kafka: transactional outbox, saga with compensation, Redis distributed locks, retries with dead-letter queues and a CQRS read model on OpenSearch.

udp.name: udp-from-scratch · Reliable Transport over UDP
udp.description: Reliable transport on raw UDP in Node.js: a 5-byte binary header, acknowledgements, per-packet retransmission and a three-way handshake that stops blind spoofing. Built to show what TCP actually solves.

lario.name: Lario
lario.description: Real-time AI voice enhancement for desktop. Local-first audio pipeline that cleans noise, restores clarity and ships entirely on-device. No audio ever leaves the machine.

smoolos.name: Smoolos · NFT Club & dApps
smoolos.description: Web3 community platform with NFT-gated access, on-chain betting and smart-contract reward mechanics. Solidity contracts wired to a Node.js backend with full Web3 wallet integration.
